# Margevia

Margevia is a product concept for supplier invoice reconciliation, designed for purchasing, operations and finance teams at restaurant groups and caterers.

## This website
- English landing page with an interactive dashboard using three fictional invoices.
- Compare agreed prices, billed prices and delivered quantities.
- Mark differences for follow-up and export sample comparisons as CSV.
- Choose a pilot team, review focus and location range locally. Send brief is unavailable pending recipient and delivery setup; no brief is downloaded or sent.
- The demo video is pending.

## Product status
This is a frontend product preview. Live document processing, OCR, supplier contact, accounting integrations and recovered savings are not implemented or claimed. Data is fictional.
